summary: Lists commonly used module utilities such as api.py, basic.py, common/ helpers for dicts, files, text, parameters, sys_info and validation, facts/, json_utils.py, powershell/, secrets.py, six, splitter.py and urls.py.
questions: Which module_util helps with HTTP requests?
Is there a helper for validating module parameters?
How can my module mask secrets in output?
Which module_util gives distribution and platform info?

answer_card.title: Standard module utilities
answer_card.answer_md:
- `api.py` generic API modules
- `basic.py` core helpers
- `common/dict_transformations.py`, `common/file.py`, `common/text/`, `common/parameters.py`, `common/validation.py`
- `common/sys_info.py` distro/platform info
- `facts/` for fact modules
- `json_utils.py` strip noise around JSON output
- `powershell/` Windows helpers
- `secrets.py` register secrets for masking
- `six/` Py2/3 compatibility
- `splitter.py` Jinja2 string splitting
- `urls.py` HTTP/HTTPS requests
